    The path category of a finite acyclic quiver #

    For a finite acyclic quiver Q, the category PathCat Q has the vertices as objects and the paths, together with a zero morphism, as morphisms. It is a finite ray category (RayCat.PathCat.isRayCategory); its linearization is the path algebra kQ.
